description: Reads how many people registered, how many came live, how many stayed long enough to see the offer and how many watched the replay — with the show-up rate. Read-only, changes nothing. Use it when the host asks how many showed up, what the show-up rate is, whether the reminders worked, or who watched the replay. Do not use it for money or per-person data. Rates are only reported when at least 20 people were in the earlier step; below that the answer says so instead of inventing a percentage. Without a connected site the answer carries example numbers (sample: true) and the next step.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

utm.description: Filter the numbers by one UTM value, e.g. a source such as facebook.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id. Leave it out when the session already built one.

name: wi_get_webinar_attendance_stats
title: Read webinar attendance and show-up rate
